Unlimited Kling 4 is now live on Runway.

Sign up for a new Max or Team plan to get 3 days of unlimited access. Plus 25% off Kling 4 on all plans. Get started at the link below. https://t.co/AthV6pDo0c

Space Bunny was OpenRouter’s #1 model for 10 straight days, processing 56.7T tokens! The most of any stealth model we’ve run.

Space Bunny hopped off OpenRouter on Oct 5. It's back today as @MiniMax_AI's M3.1 Flash, and it's free for the next 72 hours. https://t.co/2i0HsEibp5

Looking for a weekend project? Two new OpenRouter cookbooks on @scaledown_team's task-specific models (currently 20% off!), each a ready-to-run recipe for a workflow problem.

Bolt is free for EVERYONE. For the ENTIRE weekend.

Starting at 12:00am PT October 17. 
Build it Saturday, ship it Sunday, submit by Oct 20 for a shot at $10K.

Ready to build? Details here 👉 https://t.co/vzI8Nngl7G https://t.co/TZGAFoiY8Y

Open-weight models processed 73% of total tokens so far this week.

We are also accepting suggestions for new public charts! https://t.co/Q2Rfen4cxa
